visual_direction: Dark & gritty street style — black backgrounds, bold graffiti-inspired typography, vivid accent colour.

layouts.hero: Kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal, full screen or large height. Text over dark gritty urban photography with strong overlay.
layouts.marquee: Endless scrolling editorial marquee. Use react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text or solid acid yellow.
layouts.programmes: Bento grid (Mode A: 'Tetris' grid). Asymmetrical layout, thick borders or no borders with varied background colors (some dark grey, some with imagery).
layouts.get_involved: High contrast section, heavy typography, clear call to action.
layouts.contact: Minimalist, brutalist form. 1px solid borders on inputs, bright acid yellow submit button.

motion.scrolling: Smooth momentum scrolling using lenis or @studio-freight/react-lenis.
motion.reveal: Scroll-reveal animations for sections using Framer Motion (fade up, line-by-line text reveal).
motion.hover: High contrast hover states. Image scale-up on hover inside bento grid items.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the entire site to enhance the gritty feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use sharp 1px borders (border-white/10) for bento grids to give a brutalist, structured feel.
visual_enhancers.images: Grayscale or desaturated urban photography mixed with high-visibility accent colors.

components: framer-motion for kinetic text and scroll reveals
Shadcn UI for Form, Input, Textarea, Button (customized for brutalist style, sharp corners rounded-none)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure acid yellow text/buttons have dark text inside them for > 4.5:1 ratio. (e.g. text-black on bg-accent)
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.

hero_background.description: Smiling man and three friends posing in black and white

programmes_mentoring.description: Five young men stand by a vehicle on a street

texture_overlay.description: womans face with black hair and black eye shadow graffiti

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lenis, react-fast-marquee.
Implement React routing for Home, About/Our Objects, Programmes, Get Involved, Contact.
Apply a global dark theme by default. Set body background to #050505 and text to #FFFFFF.
Import Google Fonts: Anton and Manrope.
Hero Section: Use Framer Motion to create a masked line-by-line reveal for the main heading.
Marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Make the text massive, uppercase, with an outline effect (-webkit-text-stroke: 1px #E0FF00; color: transparent;).
Programmes: Implement a Bento grid. Use varied span sizes (col-span-1, col-span-2) to create visual tension.
Contact Form: Build a functional form. Connect it to the FastAPI backend which should use Resend to send emails to contact@forwardmovement.org.uk.
Do not include any donation buttons, links, or features.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for testing.
Use sharp corners (rounded-none) for most UI elements to fit the gritty/brutalist style.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use grid, diagonals, and negative space to guide flow.
Create depth through layered design elements, but avoid soft shadows. Use sharp, brutalist shadows or 1px borders instead.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors with texture.
Never use pure #000000. Tint it slightly or use #050505.
Ensure contrast ratios are accessible. The acid yellow (#E0FF00) should have dark text (#000000) when used as a background for buttons or badges.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or headers over content. Use solid dark backgrounds or heavily blurred glassmorphism.
Buttons should have clear hover states (e.g., color inversion or sharp translate offsets).
